mode: Synthetic development only; real CLI is disabled until separately authorized

manifest.coverage: Explicit site IDs and expected hourly timestamp range per model/round/fold
manifest.provenance: Immutable forecast hash, model training cutoff, decision schedule, prediction_kind=oos or synthetic_oos, fixed grouping hashes
manifest.holdout: Excluded by default, not a source of thresholds or model selection

time: Timezone-aware KST-compatible hourly interval END; textual +09:00 source convention verified locally before historical use
unresolved: Phase 2 CSVs do not alone establish decision_at, trained_through, forecast_round or horizon. A separately verified local manifest is mandatory. Never invent these fields or derive plant predictions from group predictions.
direct_groups: May be validated against plant sums only when lineage says plant_aggregation; direct-group models must be analyzed as direct groups and cannot supply plant cancellation. Direct-only runner is not implemented in this draft.
